'''''A Different Dance''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 34|thirty-forth chapter]] of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* The [[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 5|fifth chapter]] of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
